title: 第四課 Taking Care of Your Eyes
subtitle: 11/17–11/18 · 課本 p.36–39

slides.title: 課文大意：好好照顧眼睛
points: 眼睛每天都在用，所以要 take good care of them（好好照顧）。
常讓眼睛休息，才不會 tired（疲勞）：20-20-20 rule——每 20 分鐘，看 20 英尺外的東西 20 秒。
用手機或 computer（電腦）時記得 blink（眨眼），眨眼讓眼睛保持 moist（濕潤）。
看書或用手機時要 turn on（打開）燈，在 low light（昏暗光線）下用眼睛會更快累。
examples: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
Blinking keeps your eyes moist.

slides.title: 對話大意：保護眼睛的好習慣
points: Betty 在眼鏡行外面：I have an eye appointment. 她遵守 20-20-20 rule。
Ken 熬夜只睡四小時，眼睛 dry（乾）、東西看起來 blurry（模糊），但他忍著不 rub（揉）眼睛，因為會散播 germs（細菌）。
多吃 carrots（胡蘿蔔）、蛋和魚，喝足夠的水；太陽出來時戴 sunglasses（太陽眼鏡）。
每一到兩年檢查一次眼睛：get my eyes checked。
examples: Too little sleep can affect your eyesight.
You should go once every one to two years.

slides.title: 重點單字（一）
points: eye (n) 眼睛：My sister has big eyes.
take care of (idiom) 照顧：Amy takes good care of her sister.
tired (adj) 累的；疲勞的：Sandra was tired after the school event.
computer (n) 電腦：Every student at school has a computer.
turn on (phr v) 打開 ↔ turn off 關掉：Can someone turn on the fan?
slides.tip: 代名詞要放中間：turn it on ✓，turn on it ✗

slides.title: 重點單字（二）
points: dry (adj) 乾的 ↔ moist (adj) 濕潤的：My skin gets dry in the winter.
rub (v) 揉；搓：rub – rubbed – rubbed；I rubbed my hands because I was cold.
germ (n) 細菌：There are germs on it.
carrot (n) 胡蘿蔔：I like to eat carrots for a snack.
sunglasses (n) 太陽眼鏡：I like your cool sunglasses.
blink (v) 眨眼；eyesight (n) 視力；blurry (adj) 模糊的
slides.tip: sunglasses 永遠用複數：a pair of sunglasses；These sunglasses are cool.

slides.title: 複合名詞：名詞＋名詞
points: 前面的名詞說明後面名詞的種類、特性或材質。
eye appointment 眼科預約、coffee shop 咖啡店、bus stop 公車站、paper cup 紙杯
examples: I have an eye appointment.
I meet my friends at the coffee shop every Sunday.
There is a bus stop in front of my school.
Please do not use a paper cup for hot coffee.

slides.title: 片語：remind
points: remind oneself / someone to + V：提醒自己／某人去做某事
remind someone of + 名詞：提醒某人某事；讓某人想起…
examples: I remind myself to blink when I'm using my phone or computer.
I set an alarm to remind myself to turn off the stove.
Please remind me to buy milk on my way home.
Can you remind Dad of the family dinner tonight?
This old photo reminds me of my childhood.

slides.title: sleep 當名詞：睡眠（不可數）
points: sleep 常當動詞「睡覺」，也可以當不可數名詞「睡眠」。
four hours of sleep、get some sleep、a good night's sleep、lose sleep over…
examples: I only got four hours of sleep.
You look tired. Go get some sleep.
Don't lose sleep over tomorrow's test.
I had a good night's sleep last night.
slides.tip: 不可數：some sleep ✓，a sleep／sleeps ✗（a good night's sleep 是固定說法）

slides.title: 句型：protect A from B
points: 保護 A 不受 B 的傷害；from 有「遠離」的意思。
保護自己用反身代名詞：protect ourselves / myself from…
examples: Protect your eyes from the sun.
We wear coats to protect ourselves from the cold.
A helmet protects your head from injury.
Parents protect their children from danger.

slides.title: 句型：I … myself to …
points: 反身代名詞：myself、yourself、himself、herself、ourselves、themselves
主詞和受詞是同一個人時，受詞用反身代名詞。
examples: I taught myself to read and write.
I pushed myself to get the work done.
I remind myself to blink.

slides.title: 句型：When …, it's good to …；keep + 受詞 + 形容詞
points: When + 情況, it's good to + 原形動詞：在…的時候，做…是好的
keep + 受詞 + 形容詞：讓…保持某狀態
So + be/助動詞 + 主詞：…也是（So are eggs and fish.）
examples: When the sun is out, it's good to wear sunglasses.
When you feel sad, it's good to talk to someone.
When it is dark outside, it's good to take a flashlight.
Blinking keeps your eyes moist.
